## Change

What concrete problem does this solve, and what behavior changes?

## Verification

List commands and actual results. Separate offline/fake-host tests from live FL evidence. Describe any remaining limitation.

## Review checks

- [ ] Relevant tests/checks ran; failures and skipped qualification are stated.
- [ ] Tool reference and user guides match changed behavior.
- [ ] Identity/revision/input-policy checks remain intact.
- [ ] No private paths, credentials, commercial media or unlicensed fixtures were added.
- [ ] Source and upstream attribution are preserved.
